notes.title: Character Expansion DLC Vol.2! Enjoy New Content for Free!
notes.content:
[p]At long last—it’s here![/p][p]Thank you all for waiting so patiently. Today, we’re finally releasing the second DLC for Handyman Fantasy 🤗
[/p][p]I’m sure many of you have already guessed who the characters in the silhouette were, right?[/p][p]The answer is… the Guild Receptionist & the Shopkeeper Lady ✨✨[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/12eb33aacda83facc53986f2d8e1a59a052e6a44.png"][/img]
Unlock conditions for the two new characters:[/p][list][*][p]Corrupt all female characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Bring the twin dragon sisters home.[/p][/*][*][p]For the Shopkeeper Lady, you’ll need to purchase all her items (excluding consumables).[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/4db5b61968aac21a713ce995e9a3b226a0fca2b4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/65e17e693614f169f51baabf25b714f3419aaabd.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve planned a total of three free DLC waves. DLC3 is already in production, and we hope to bring it to you very soon!
[/p][p]Also, the third update is expected to be released simultaneously on both DLsite and FANZA 🙂 We’re deeply sorry to have kept users on those platforms waiting 🙇‍♂️ Our goal is to ensure that when the game launches there, it will include all content from DLC1–3 in one complete package, so that everyone can enjoy the best experience possible. 🙇‍🙇‍[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Two Weeks Since Release – A Look Back & Free DLC Announcement!
notes.content:
[p]It's been two weeks since the release of [b]Handyman Fantasy[/b], and once again, we’ve received an overwhelming amount of support and feedback from so many players. We’re truly grateful—thank you all so much![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/375f518ddd07d87b035faccd8fb1afcd3ff46dfe.png"][/img][/p][p]Because our previous title received such a warm response, we felt even more pressure during the development of this game. With a strong desire to create something that would surpass our last work, our entire team poured everything we had into this project. Even so, we were incredibly nervous leading up to launch. But seeing everyone’s kind comments and enjoyment of the game has made it all feel worthwhile.[/p][p]We’ve received a ton of feedback—game impressions, reviews, bug reports—and we sincerely appreciate everyone who took the time to share their thoughts. We read every single message carefully, and all of your input will be a huge help as we continue to grow and improve. Once again, thank you from the bottom of our hearts![/p][p][/p][p]And now, we have a few important announcements to share:[/p][h3][b]🌟 We’ve officially started work on a free DLC![/b]
 Development is already underway, and we’re planning to release it as a free update in the near future as a small way to give back to everyone who has supported us. We’re putting a lot of care into this content—please look forward to it![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/0933a5b24a2df1e7d02d89ddb2ebdce7a84e3e78.png"][/img][/p][h3]🛠 [b]A DLsite version is also coming soon, along with a playable demo![/b]
 In response to players who prefer platforms outside of Steam, we're working hard to bring the game to DLsite. The store page and demo will be launching in the near future, so please stay tuned![/h3][p][/p][p]We’ll continue doing our best to make sure your experience in the world of [b]Handyman Fantasy[/b] is as enjoyable as possible. Once again, thank you to all our amazing players![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: "Handyman Fantasy" OUT NOW! Digital Artbook Also Available!
notes.content: [p]Developed by SupaShinken Studio, the 18+ RPG Handyman Fantasy—featuring an unique blend of Isekai × Part-Time Jobs × Character Growth—is officially available on Steam starting today![/p][p]In this adult adventure, you play as a humble handyman who gets transported to another world while fixing a toilet. To survive, you’ll take on odd jobs, romance a cast of diverse heroines, and power up by collecting “Lust Energy” to uncover clues about how to return home.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/6bf957de341c5b0dc6a30ab36bbbdfe5af4b6003.png"][/img][/p][p]As the official sequel to the Handyman series, Handyman Fantasy offers a more expansive system, deeper character interactions, and even spicier H-mode content. Alongside the game’s release, a Digital Artbook DLC is now available, featuring over 40 pages of sketches, character designs, never-before-seen CGs, and exclusive bonus illustrations—twice the volume of the previous title![/p][p][/p][p]Key Features:[/p][p]• Variety of part-time jobs – Forge weapons at the blacksmith, serve drinks at a tavern, organize holy texts at a church, or even act as a “supporter” for female adventurers![/p][p]• Unique heroine routes & corruption system – Each girl features her own mini-games, H-mode mechanics, and a late-game “personality breakdown” path for wildly different romantic experiences.[/p][p]• Lust Energy system – Interact with characters to gather lust energy, which can be spent to unlock skills, strengthen abilities, and access more “fun” content.[/p][p]• High-customization H system – Clothing toggle, sleep play, first-person view, tentacle ON/OFF settings—tailored for all kinds of fetishes![/p][p]From a tsundere elf adventurer, a sexually frustrated minotaur wife, a perpetually drunk cat-eared maid, a two-faced holy sister, to a mysterious demoness boss—Handyman Fantasy offers a variety of seductive romances across styles and kinks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/fabe1a0852b1f6ae3e8a1903ee328b4f10e6e31d.png"][/img][/p][p]Cat Maid: She gets really handsy when drunk.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/f8a217e23e513fbc897f1ba517350edacc53787d.png"][/img][/p][p]Minotaur Wife: Her husband’s always forging; she just wants to be hammered.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/54d86ac914dc97c673f93f44011e9f689219f702.png"][/img][/p][p]Elf: Tsundere + lust rune = power spike.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/20fc28c49a25cd94e86cb6d5f9dfe454c0a76faf.png"][/img][/p][p]Naughty Nun: Hides porn in the church bookshelf, blushes while confessing.[/p][p][/p][p]Yes, the succubus literally sucks the life (and libido) out of you—making this an Isekai grind like no other.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/2daf2304300f02f070ebfe5391006dbff98157a3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/95c568463e4e20346d2cb3206b35d00694d5b965.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/52dfb158646a033d875e11f747b3647f00289cd6.png"][/img][/p][p]A Deeper Look: Digital Artbook DLC[/p][p]Launching alongside the game, the Digital Artbook DLC offers an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the creative process: early concept designs, character evolution sketches, unused CG drafts, and layout storyboards for H-scenes—all in a 40+ page collection.[/p][p](Note: The artbook is purely bonus content and does not affect core gameplay.)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/5e91bcb6438662b7ffd498a8c9d0c32795b21aaf.png"][/img][/p][p]Explore deeper lore, character backgrounds, and hidden connections through the artbook content.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Thanks for Your Support[/b][/h3][h3][b]Since the demo launch and throughout Steam Next Fest, we’ve received tons of feedback, bug reports, and suggestions. We sincerely thank all players who supported us. Your input helped shape a better, bolder, and more satisfying Isekai-H experience.[/b][/h3][p]Steam Page: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690010/Handyman_Fantasy/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 2025/04/10　June Demo in the Works! Sister Lisa’s Exclusive Play
notes.content:
The scenario writing for Handyman Fantasy is finally complete! 🎉
 We’re now moving into translation and Japanese voice recording!

As for the supported languages—
This time, Handyman Fantasy will support Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Thai.
All characters will be fully voiced in Japanese only, no matter the language setting!

If everything goes smoothly, we plan to implement all of these languages in the demo version scheduled for release in June!
This title also features more dialogue scenes between characters than ever before—paired with full voice acting, we’re aiming to bring you a deeper and more immersive story experience.

🌟 And here’s some more exciting news!
 We’re also planning to release a Digital Artbook alongside the game!

It’ll include character concepts, development sketches, promo illustrations, and of course…
A special selection of extra spicy illustrations just for you ♥
 With over 40 pages, it’s double the size of the previous volume!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/d4e8bf61fd0e301ab961d5844cbe715fb98d7278.png[/img]

The artbook is completely optional and won’t affect gameplay. If you’d like to support us, it’ll be a very juicy way to do so!

----------------------

Now then…
 Let us introduce the purest (…?) character in the cast—Sister Lisa, and her special, sinful little route!

Raise your intimacy level with Lisa, get to know her heart (and body), and you’ll unlock a secret "confession room" play feature!
 But be careful—someone might be just outside the door… 👀

Once she’s fallen, you’ll unlock more actions, more events, and maybe even…
 more people⁉️ (΄◞ิ౪◟ิ‵)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/7b7609d902c64f96e8c06fc04231bb428aa49e9b.gif[/img]

 Stop watching. Start participating.
 Do everything it takes to break through Sister Lisa’s holy little heart. ლ(◉◞౪◟◉ )ლ

notes.title: 2025/03/20 Development Progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone~ 😏
After posting our last progress update, we received a lot of feedback on the sleep assault main screen. We've seen all your suggestions! After discussing internally, we realized that adding different animations based on specific actions during interactions with the heroine can significantly enhance the gameplay experience. So, we immediately worked on improving it, as shown below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/d01621e1ef03911d822dff1b74ba1edd5425299d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/cb7f8af0b5870397d1fc6d5ae5889a23d6383409.gif[/img]

This is our revised sleep assault mode! In addition to the small sub-screen in the top left corner, we've also added animations in the center—making everything feel much more immersive! Now, you can fully indulge in this forbidden yet intoxicating experience! (//▽//) Whether you prefer clothed or naked mode, there are dedicated animations for both, and even special effects when climaxing or ejaculating!

One of the new mechanics we’ve introduced in this game is something deliciously wicked—the Lust Energy System.
 ▼▼▼▼▼
The core gameplay? "Train" various female characters, harvest Lust Energy, and convert it into skill points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/36e61f16618954eba9acd7471ef867aec0f54a98.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/4bb1f5d1017356aa6bf4e73ed6dfa6543275ba93.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/4bb1f5d1017356aa6bf4e73ed6dfa6543275ba93.gif[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/75e73f2082e1d0b03ad12842eb16d52624535052.png[/img]
Hmm… yeah, this is the process where the succubus helps you convert Lust Energy into skill points…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/a070b7531eaeff9f1b51463351bcb2da037e238d.png[/img]
And trust me, these skill points are extremely useful! You can use them to boost your stamina, increase work rewards, dramatically raise the success rate of certain H-scenes, or send a girl’s corruption level skyrocketing. Most importantly—you can unlock even kinkier and darker H-features!

So don’t hold back—go hunt down those women! 😈✨ (΄◞ิ౪◟ิ‵)！！

Once you progress far enough into the story, our lovely succubus will even send her minions to monitor Mrs.Minotaur and her husband’s daily life 24/7, giving you better strategies for your "conquest."

As your relationship with Mrs.Minotaur deepens… she’ll start wavering, and eventually, she might be willing to abandon her husband for you. Steal her away and claim your rightful throne as the NTR King! 🏆💦
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/373d68a138983e33d90af06934ab6fa681ee5617.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/aa64436f905d3e7e479e7f4157fb293b1c7de035.gif[/img]

And of course, the succubus’s role doesn’t stop here—more updates on her involvement coming soon! ☺️

notes.title: 2025/02/21 Development Progress
notes.content:
🔥 Thank You for Your Support! 🔥
Since our Steam page launch, our wishlist count is nearing 20,000!! 🥳🎉
Handyman Fantasy is planned for release on both Steam and DLsite, so for those who prefer DLsite, no worries! Once we’re ready, we’ll open up our DLsite page as well!


💤 The Tavern Hostess' "Sleep Play" System💤
Today, let’s briefly introduce the exclusive "Sleep Play" system for our Tavern Hostess (Don’t worry, everything happens with her consent—this is a proper game! ). While this system is still being refined, we’d love to show you our current progress. If you have any suggestions, feel free to leave a comment!


After building a good relationship with the hostess, you’ll sometimes get the chance to enjoy a tipsy late-night chat with her (or maybe... make her completely blackout? 😏). Of course, at first, you stand no chance against her...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/74d97aa91c641df8466952e8a35af761e1e0ff2d.jpg[/img]

But once you learn the right tricks (through items or skills… you get it )... hehe, the situation completely changes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/9ef35dca075ce2c4a9650802d80c6efd37a24805.png[/img]

For all the heroines in this game—whether it’s regular H-scenes or character-specific ones—we’ve incorporated a lot of feedback from our previous game. This time, we’ve added options for clothing on/off, with some outfits even allowing partial undressing. While this approach has increased development costs, judging from the results so far… it’s totally worth it! The immersion during those intimate moments will be next-level... (΄◞ิ౪◟ิ‵)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/0b7be9088ecfa045afc249770cbfac386dae6f83.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/cc6f798e29c3b3a168dbdeff2f9f300a53d79496.gif[/img]

Right now, this system is still in development, and we plan to add more items, interaction buttons, and features to make it even more engaging. Stay tuned, gentlemen! 🚀💦

📢 Regarding the Official Release Date 📢
Many of you have been asking when the game will officially launch—we’re really sorry, but we can’t promise an exact date yet. (〒︿〒)
BUT! A FREE DEMO IS GUARANTEED! 📢
Our current plan is to release it in about three months (we’ll try our best to make it sooner!). We’ll keep grinding and share any updates as we go. Thank you all for your patience and support! (｀д´)ゝ
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690010/Handyman_Fantasy/
▲ Follow our Steam page to make sure you don’t miss the demo release and official launch updates!
